category.reason: Distinguish the bright red swatch from darker red swatches by color; no ordinal position identifies the target.

instruction.en: Click the bright red color swatch in the first row.
instruction.zh: 点击第一行的亮红色色块。

reference.patch: Added instruction.en by translating the original Chinese instruction. The original request, "点击第一行第二个红色" ("Click the second red option in the first row"), supplied a row and ordinal position that already selected the bright red swatch without requiring color recognition. Rewrote both instructions to ask for the bright red swatch in the first row, removing the second-item clue and making the color distinction from the darker red swatches explicit. Updated category.reason to describe this color-based distinction; the target swatch and ground-truth box are unchanged.
